label_mapping.reference: Same stored frozen completed-second VWAP for return labels and price-band direction.
label_mapping.convention: Up iff actual future close > frozen reference; exact equality is down-or-unchanged. No bin straddles zero.
label_mapping.separate_two_bp_convention: Exact +2bp moves to bin16; this does not affect the sign boundary.

raw_recovery: Invert the saved 26-way temperature transform: softmax(log(p_cal)*T); exact round trip checked on every head.

calibration.method: One scalar temperature per horizon chosen on 49 log-spaced values 0.5–4 to minimize 26-bin log loss on separate calibration dates.
calibration.fold_C: 25 origins: no temperature fit, all T=1.
calibration.ranking_warning: 26-way temperature then sum positive bins is not necessarily monotone in the original binary sum; AUC can change.

baseline_objective.flow_logistic: Linear 15×26 multiclass logits trained by categorical cross entropy; NOT direct binary logistic.
baseline_objective.lifetime_logistic: An existing direct binary diagnostic exists at 105/345/945 seconds, but uses the subset with all auxiliary short-horizon labels available; not the full matched primary cohort.

limitations: All August periods are reused development evidence; no fresh improvement claim.
Overlapping targets and few calendar days make group frequencies and AUC descriptive; no IID significance claim.
AUC is undefined for single-class daily/horizon slices; reported as null, never replaced with 0.5.
Probability quartiles are computed per period from predictions only, keep equal scores together, and do not define a trading threshold.
Raw reconstruction is sampled against neural checkpoints, not re-inferred for every original forecast.
scope_of_compact_copy: Selected-family six runs: every horizon, partition and day, plus transfer probability groups. All seven method-family means retained. Other methods remain in the private complete diagnostic.
